instruction: Fix the typo in cell A1 of best_awards_acl.xlsx on the desktop — it currently says 'tile' but should say 'title'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated ACL Anthology, browsed ACL 2021 long papers proceedings, searched for 'ACL 2021 best paper award' with no results, tried Google/Semantic Scholar but failed to identify award papers. Never entered data into spreadsheet. Hit 50-turn limit.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate ACL Anthology, browse conference proceedings pages, use search bars, switch between Chrome tabs. Can interact with LibreOffice Calc (file was open).
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed because ACL Anthology does not label best paper awards on proceedings pages. The model spent all 50 turns searching for award info across multiple sites without success, never returning to edit the spreadsheet.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed to simplest spreadsheet-only sub-task: fixing a typo in a cell header. Tests basic LibreOffice Calc editing capability demonstrated by the model having the app open.
metadata.explanation: Task requires correcting a typo in cell A1 from 'tile' to 'title'. Evaluator reads A1 and checks case-insensitive match against expected value 'title'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads cell A1 from the target file best_awards_acl.xlsx, which is the exact cell specified in the instruction.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' — accesses expected.get('expected_value') directly without incorrect nesting.
Case-insensitive comparison is appropriate for a typo fix task (accepts 'Title', 'TITLE', 'title', etc.).
Postconfig properly activates the LibreOffice window and saves the file (Ctrl+S) before evaluation, ensuring fresh file state.
Expected value 'title' is semantically correct — the instruction states the typo is 'tile' and the correct value is 'title'.
Single-requirement instruction is fully covered by the single getter+metric pair.
